modules.title: Introduction to Calculus (Advanced)
modules.html:
Differentiation, integration and their applications. This section covers introduction to calculus (advanced).

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of calculus (advanced).
  • Be able to explain calculus (advanced) in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Differentiate $$ y = 4x^3 - 2x^2 + 5 $$.
A: $$ 12x^2 - 4x $$ — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: $$ 12x^2 - 4x $$.

Q: Evaluate $$ \int_0^2 (2x + 1) dx $$.
A: 6 — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 6.
